description: `predict.py run --tta flip8 [--tta-levels L]`: deform_tta in the streamed engine (design 3.3), TTA stages in StreamedRunner incl. --levels plans and the affine+deform source lifetime (3.4, 3.5, review v1 finding 2), CLI flags and validation (7.1), predict.json tta_record / tta_spread.csv / warnings / non-finite flips (5, 7.4, 7.5), tests T5, T6, T7, T10 and end-to-end runs. Depends on FEAT-001 (inference/tta.py, estimate tta_levels, golden).
steps: 1. inference/streaming.py: move the P0-P11 body of StreamedLevel.deform verbatim into `_v_raw_passes(self, n, bounds, stats, input_fn)` returning `acc.s` (float32 group sum [1, X, Y, Z, 3]; it stores '<prefix>v_raw' and frees d2 / x_in as today); deform() = k/bounds/stats setup + `sum_v = self._v_raw_passes(...)`, `mean_v = sum_v / float(n)` + the unchanged P12 loop. Same tf.function keys and call order. Run tests.test_predict_tta_golden and tests.test_predict_streaming immediately: must pass before continuing.

2. inference/streaming.py: `deform_tta(self, n, input_fn, flips, prev_fn=None, sink=None, mask_fn=None)` per design 3.3: bounds/stats once (chunk bounds from the deform task); allocate host stores 'tta_s1' [n,X,Y,Z,3] f32, 'tta_s2' [n,X,Y,Z,1] f32, 'tta_c0' [n,X,Y,Z,3] f32 (via self._put on first chunk or store.alloc with the prefix); sm = zeros [1,X,Y,Z,3] tf.float32; for f_idx, flip in enumerate(flips): stats_f = self._new_stats(...); input_fn_f(i0, i1) = tta.flip_np(input_fn(i0, i1), flip); sum_f = self._v_raw_passes(n, bounds, stats_f, input_fn_f); m_f = tta.unflip_field(sum_f / n, flip); sm += m_f; one chunk loop with `_f_tta_acc(flip, first)` (cached via self._fn(('tta_acc', flip, first), body)): r = unflip_field(v_raw_chunk), s1 = r (first) or s1 + r, s2 = (s2 +) reduce_sum((r - m_f)^2, -1, keepdims), c0 = r - m_f for the identity flip; write back with store.put; check finiteness of v_raw per flip (record flip index in a nonfinite list, WARNING with level and flip); free 'v_raw'; merge stats_f fp16 maxima into stats (max) and keep stats_f chunks of flip 0; time per flip. Then P12 with v_raw chunk = s1/8 (tf.constant from the store chunk / len(flips)) and mean_v = sm / len(flips) through the existing `_f_p12(prev_fn is not None)` (sink receives v_raw = averaged raw, v = centered average) or `_put('u'/'u_inv')`; then spread pass `_f_tta_spread` per chunk with mask = mask_fn(i0, i1) or ones: c_bar = s1/F - m_bar, sigma2 = max(0, s2/F - |c_bar|^2), per image spread_rms_mm = sqrt(mean_mask sigma2) * spacing, shift_mm = sqrt(mean_mask |c0 - c_bar|^2) * spacing, sigma map pulled to host per image for spread_p99_mm = np.percentile(sigma[mask], 99) * spacing (spacing = P.LEVEL_SPACING[level]); free tta_s1/s2/c0; stats['max_abs_v'], stats['tta'] = {flips: [...], nonfinite_flips: [...], timing_s: [per flip], spread: {spread_rms_mm: [n], spread_p99_mm: [n], shift_mm: [n]}}; last_stats; same return dict as deform(). StreamedLevel.linear unchanged.

3. inference/runner.py: StreamedRunner.__init__(..., plan=None, tta=None) (tta: tta.TTAConfig or None; store `self.tta`); `_tta_at(lv)` = tta is not None and lv in tta.levels; `_linear_stage(lv, eng, model, n, input_fn, task, a_prev, x1)`: if not _tta_at(lv) or tta.flips == IDENTITY_ONLY -> today's two lines exactly (eng.linear; tf.cast(model.centering(a_raw), tf.float32) or CS.compose_linear(a_raw, a_prev, model.centering)); else for each flip: a_raw_f = eng.linear(n, lambda i0, i1: tta.flip_np(input_fn(i0, i1), flip), task), M_f = tta.unflip_matrices(a_raw_f, flip); collect fp16 maxima of each pass (eng.last_stats merged; _record after the stage); res = tta.linear_tta_level(M_flips, a_prev, model.centering, task, flips); spreads with tta.linear_spread (S per image from self._second_moments(x1) = tfm.brain_second_moment(x1[i, ..., 0] > 0, 1.0) computed once per run and cached) and tta.gauge_size(tta.gauge_barycenters(M_flips, a_prev, model.config.centering_iters)); WARNING for any image with readout_dev_deg > 1 or rot_gap < 1e-3 (subject index, level); append rows to self._tta_rows (dict image index, level, task + columns; spread_p99_mm None) and self._tta_gauge[(lv, task)]; return res['A']. Replace the two-line blocks in `_linear` and `_linear_sel` by `_linear_stage` (inside the same phases context). `_deform_stage(lv, eng, n, input_fn, prev_fn, sink)`: eng.deform(...) unless TTA at lv with flips != IDENTITY_ONLY, else eng.deform_tta(n, input_fn, self.tta.flips, prev_fn=prev_fn, sink=sink, mask_fn=self._mask_fn(lv)) and rows from stats['tta']; used in `_deform` and `_deform_sel`. Level mask: when any deform level of the branch is a TTA level, compute once at the start of `_deform` / `_deform_sel` (before the first P0) m1 = mean_i 1[src_i > 0] >= 0.5 by one chunked pass over src (chunk l1), pooled to each level with CS.pool_to_coarser on float32 and thresholded at 0.5, stored as uint8 numpy per level; `_mask_fn(lv)` returns a function (i0, i1) -> broadcast mask [i1-i0, X, Y, Z, 1] float32. src_affine lifetime: install the free-after-last-P0 wrapper only when `is_last and free_src and not self._tta_at(lv)`; when the last level is a TTA level and free_src, wrap the `_deform_stage` call in try/finally that frees SRC_AFFINE if still in the store. summary['tta'] = None without TTA, else {rows, gauge {'l<lv>/<task>': [deg, mm]}, nonfinite_flips {'l<lv>/<task>': [...]}, timing_s {'l<lv>/<task>': [...]}, flips}. UnchunkedRunner: unchanged (refused in the CLI).

4. inference/cli.py: `--tta` choices ('none', 'flip8') default 'none' with help text (8 group flips, gauge-free averaging, design milestone 10); `--tta-levels` type _levels (parse_levels), default None, help 'levels with TTA (default: all levels the plan runs)'; validate(): `--tta-levels` given and tta != 'flip8' -> parser.error; tta == 'flip8' and mode == 'unchunked' -> parser.error; OUTPUT_NAMES += ('tta_spread.csv',). check-streaming gets no TTA flags. Keep the module TF-free.

5. inference/predict.py: PREDICT_KEYS += ('tta_record',) (null in _new_record); `_peek_flip_chain(checkpoint, level)` (plan D10: _peek_chain_configs + level-4 config: level-2 run -> cascade.source_config; level-1 run -> level-2 config's cascade.source_config, else the level-1 config's cascade.stages level-4 origin_checkpoint through runtime.checkpoint.source_config_path; unreadable -> (path or None, None)); `_setup_tta(args, rec, plan, level)`: None for 'none'; else levels = args.tta_levels or plan.run; any level not in plan.run -> PredictError(EXIT_INPUT, ...) after setting rec['tta_record'] = {'mode', 'levels' requested, 'error'}; probs = tta.train_flip_probs(_peek_flip_chain(...)); log tta.flip_prob_warnings as WARNING; rec['tta_record'] = TTAConfig.to_dict() + linear_averaging, svf_accumulation, train_flip_prob {str(level): p}; returns TTAConfig. In _run_predict: call after _setup_levels; estimate_store_gb(..., tta_levels=cfg.levels if cfg and the branch has deform else ()); StreamedRunner(..., plan=plan, tta=cfg); pipeline text + ' with 8-flip TTA at levels %s' when cfg; after the run, when summary['tta']: write <out>/tta_spread.csv (header: subject, subject_dir, level, task, then tta.SPREAD_COLUMNS; one row per subject x level x task; empty string for None) and add it to rec['outputs']; rec['tta_record'].update(spread=tta.summarize_spread(rows) + gauge, nonfinite_flips, timing_s); INFO per level/task: mean and max spread_rms_mm, mean shift_mm, gauge; when the run ends non-finite (exit 3) and nonfinite_flips is non-empty, extend the message with the flips (ERROR log). Exit codes unchanged otherwise.

6. tests/test_predict_tta.py (imports tests.tf_setup first; reuse tests.test_predict_runner _level4/_level2/_collect/RunnerCase, tests.predict_helpers, tests.test_predict _run/_json): TestIdentityOnly (T5: StreamedRunner(..., tta=TTAConfig('flip8', levels=all, flips=IDENTITY_ONLY)) vs tta=None, bitwise equal A and all fields, rigid, affine, deform, affine+deform at level 4 and the level-2 cascade); TestEquivariance (T6, float32 policy models: TTA(flip_g x) vs F_g TTA(x) F_g for A (point RMS < 1e-4 mm with S of the image mask) and (TTA u)^F for U1, U1_inv, u_ckpt (< 1e-4 vox), g in x, y, z, xyz, branches rigid, affine, deform, affine+deform, level 4 and level-2 (TTA at all levels), N 3; plus one N 2 run; assert store.nbytes() == 0 after every run and that SRC_AFFINE is not in the store); TestEquivariantStubs (T7: StreamedLevel subclasses injected via runner._engines: (a) linear stub from intensity centroid / covariance per design T7(a), (b) B-gauge stub, (c) deform stub overriding _v_raw_passes with v_raw = alpha * central-difference gradient of x_in + constant non-symmetric c; assertions: TTA == single pass within 1e-4 mm point RMS (centered A), pairwise A_j^-1 A_i within 1e-5 mm, deform u within 1e-6 vox, spreads ~ 0, gauge_deg / gauge_mm > 0 for (b) and ~ 0 for (a); (b) with an in-test raw-averaging reference shows a pairwise error > 1e-3 mm (regression guard)); TestCLIAndRecords (T10: --tta flip8 accepted, --tta-levels without flip8 -> exit 2, flip8 with --mode unchunked -> exit 2, --tta flip still rejected, --tta-levels 1 on a level-4 checkpoint -> exit 2 with predict.json written and status error, predict.json key set == PREDICT_KEYS with tta_record None for none, tta_spread.csv only with flip8 and in --overwrite protection); TestEndToEnd (level-4 and level-2 tiny checkpoints, 3 subjects: run --tta none for rigid/deform/affine+deform -> hashes equal the golden fixture; run --tta flip8 for the same -> exit 0, finite fields, tta_record fields (mode, levels, 8 flips, train_flip_prob 0.5 per level, spread summary with gauge), tta_spread.csv rows = subjects x levels x tasks with the D4 empty-column rule; affine+deform flip8 at level 2 frees src_affine; --tta-levels 2 on the level-2 checkpoint runs TTA only at level 2 (rows only for level 2)).
7. Run the verification commands and write .agents/tasks/tta/test-log-FEAT-002.md (commands, Ran N / OK lines, skips, printed max diffs, run times).
